inlines.v: PONIARD, noun pon'yard. [Latin pugnus.] A small dagger; a pointed instrument for stabbing, borne in the hand or at the girdle, or in the pocket. PONIARD, verb transitive pon'yard. To pierce with a poniard; to stab.
